Write a short academic-style statement about the difference between a calendar anniversary and a collective memory. Aim for approximately 28–44 English tokens.

message.content: While a calendar anniversary marks a fixed chronological recurrence, collective memory constitutes a dynamic, socially constructed narrative. The former provides temporal structure, whereas the latter evolves through ongoing interpretation, reflecting contemporary values rather than merely preserving historical facts unchanged.
